notes: Each case embeds one skill body from the side under test (HEAD or worktree) and asks for a small, checkable artifact.
verify.extract: 'all' or 'fence:<lang>' (concatenates matching fenced blocks; missing fence fails).
include: optional glob patterns (relative to the skill dir) whose files are embedded after SKILL.md on the same side, capped by --include-cap chars.
verify.parse: 'python' runs ast.parse on the extracted text.
verify.must / must_not: regexes (re.M|re.S; add flags 'i' for case-insensitive). Every must must match; no must_not may match.
These check outcome properties (parses, portable, states the required fact), not adherence to the skill's wording.

cases.prompt: Write the complete minimal server module for an MCP server named `demo` with exactly one tool `ping` that returns the string "pong". Follow the skill's FastMCP conventions and its default transport; do not add HTTP unless the skill says it is the default. Reply with exactly one ```python fenced block containing the module and nothing else.
cases.note: Progressive-disclosure guard for the MCP lane: a compressed skill must still yield a parseable stdio scaffold.

cases.prompt: In two or three sentences: besides name and description, which frontmatter field must a new skill in this repo carry to pass the lint gate, and which file declares the per-skill symlinks for Claude Code?
cases.note: F15 outcome: the skill text must carry the lint-required field and the symlink manifest.

cases.prompt: Give the exact shell command(s) from the skill to query Loki logs for namespace ai-shared-prod over the last 2 hours, for a macOS machine with BSD userland and no GNU coreutils. Reply with exactly one ```bash fenced block and nothing else.
cases.note: F18 outcome: the command must not depend on GNU-only date/grep/stat/readlink on macOS.
